messages:
Maria: Quick update: tiny agenda shuffle, moving roadmap up by 10m. Also test recording failed once. AV team, can someone check mic/recorder?
Devon: On it. Reproduced an audio drop when laptop sleeps and USB hub reconnects. Temporary: disable power saving + use ethernet.
Sam: OBS hot-standby ready. Who has the backup RTMP key?
Maria: DMed keys to @Sam and @Devon (rtmp://stream.redwood-infer.example/live + key).
Irene: For Q&A, please drop concise roadmap questions here (one-liners) so we can triage. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Ill keep last 10 mins for leadership Q&A. Anything that needs a written answer well follow up on.
Devon: Caption bridge threw: "Error: caption-service timeout (503)". Ops, can we fail to SRT fallback?
OpsBot: caption-service: restarting on infra-caption-02. Fallback SRT: srt://fallback.redwood-infer:9999.
Sam: Captions came up on fallback SRT. OBS local record ready: `ffmpeg -i rtmp://local -c copy backup_ah.mp4`.
Maria: Uploading roadmap PDF to #all-hands-assets; pinning. Note: Dedicated pricing slide still has draft numbers.
Irene: Q collection: add one-line context + owning team. Example: "Dedicated->Private migration tooling? (Platform)"
Sam: Q: Will there be a migration tool for Dedicated -> Private, or is it manual? (Platform)
Devon: Q: Any planned default changes to Dedicated autoscaling next quarter? (Infra)
Maria: Q: Product, can we get a short quantization-vs-hardware compatibility matrix? (Eng-ML)
OpsBot: recording: primary recorder failed (/dev/snd busy). Failing over to recfarm-02, streaming to S3.
Devon: Backup recorder up, watching latency.
Sam: Backup stream live — ping here when you flip so I start local capture.
Maria: Flipped to backup. Quick mic check: Jordan please say "redwood all hands check".
Jordan: "redwood all hands check"
Irene: Heard clean. :thumbsup:
Sam: Local record started; captions flowing on fallback.
Maria: Proceeding with the meeting. If you want leadership follow-ups, add them now or raise :raised_hand:. I'll compile notes and open a follow-up doc after.
Devon: Monitoring audio; ping if you notice glitches.
Sam: Early log: backup-recording ~0.9GB in 8m, looks good.
Maria: Thanks team. Going live in ~2m.
